Source Monster

Monster: Quematrice | CR: 5 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

Minor Critical Status (Ignite). When you make a weapon attack with this weapon, and roll a 20 for the attack roll, the target catches fire; Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

Armor Effect

Tremor-Proof. You cannot be knocked prone while you wear this armor.

Tags: mechanic:condition, type:offensive, damage:fire, mechanic:saving-throw, type:defensive
